t_advice_summary_textbox.text: 8 different coloured gnomes, 4 assigned to yellow basket 4 to the red basket. When one colour basket decreases select the other colour gnome. Try to cash in on the 5X rounds

vb_textbox.text: There are 8 different coloured gnomes, all 8 are assigned to either a red or yellow basket. It is important to work out which gnome is assigned to which coloured basket. I found that gnomes assigned to the red basket tend to have more mushrooms. This is not always the case though as sometimes the amount of mushrooms drop while the yellow basket gnomes will gain. It is important to watch carefully and track how many mushrooms you recieve from each basket, during each round as this will help you decide which coloured basket to go to next time
